summary: BiomX Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a 1-for-10 reverse stock split, approved by stockholders on August 25, 2026, and fixed by the Board on August 28, 2026. Effective September 9, 2026, the split reduces outstanding shares from ~26.7 million to ~2.7 million, with authorized shares cut from 750 million to 150 million. Fractional shares round up; warrants and convertible instruments are proportionally adjusted. Continental Stock Transfer acts as exchange agent. The split aims to regain NYSE American listing compliance. Watch for trading resumption on a split-adjusted basis and potential delisting risk if price fails to sustain compliance.
